caption: Torque of 20 kN·m is shared between the two cells as q₁ and q₂; the equal-twist condition gives the second equation, and the shared wall then carries the difference q₁ − q₂.

spec.aria: Block diagram: a torque of 20 kN·m is split between two cells as q₁ and q₂, the equal-twist condition θ₁ = θ₂ gives a second equation, solving gives q₁ = 160.5 N/mm and q₂ = 143.2 N/mm, and the shared wall carries their difference, 17.4 N/mm.
